description: Re-scan installed skills with the latest security patterns. Detects issues like SSRF instructions, prompt injection, data exfiltration, and other threats that may not have been caught when the skill was originally installed. Run without arguments to scan all installed skills, or specify a skill name to scan one.

skillName.description: Specific skill directory name to rescan (omit to rescan all installed skills).

name: skill_rescan
title: Rescan Installed Skills
